entries.title: Work taken over at an already reviewed version keeps its review
entries.body: When a crewmate takes over another task's work and offers the very version that task's review passed, the takeover keeps that passed review, and the proof accepted with it, without a second review. Its task record and merge card say which task earned the review. A version with any new change still gets its own review. And when a crewmate records proof that nobody has started to review, your first mate hears about it at once and starts the review.

picture.alt: A taken-over task's record whose Review line reads passed in SCR-1, beside the line saying it replaces the earlier task
